source: Library of Congress, Historic American Buildings Survey / Historic American Engineering Record (https://www.loc.gov/collections/historic-american-buildings-landscapes-and-engineering-records/), item JSON API (?fo=json)
license: Public domain: works of the US government (https://www.loc.gov/rr/print/res/114_habs.html)
notes: image_url is LoC's largest service JPEG (about 1024 px); tiff_url is the master scan, listed but not downloaded.

scale is filled only when the LoC caption states it. LoC captions for HABS sheets are usually just '(sheet N of M)'; the scale and sheet title are in each drawing's title block, so read them from the image before taking a dimension.
sheet is the caption's '(sheet N of M)' number when given, otherwise the sheet's position in LoC's list. sheet_title is the title some captions lead with ('1. North front - ...').
data_pages lists each item's PDFs (kind 'data': the written HABS/HAER report, which often gives dimensions such as span lengths; 'cap': photo captions; 'supp': supplements). Not downloaded.
Structures come from config/landmarks/index.json (scripts/49_landmark_index.py) when it exists, else from the LANDMARKS table in this script.
Items in loc_items came from the LANDMARKS table or a clear search match. Uncertain search matches are in 'search' only and need review before use.
